checkpoints.note: On the witnessed fixed-text call from `hb-subset-fuzzer.cc:60`, the inner loop reaches an iteration with `close_over_gsub == true`, so `_populate_gids_to_retain` executes GSUB closure on the attacker-controlled face and dispatches into GSUB lookup subtables.

The first vulnerability-relevant project statement on the witnessed path resolves the attacker-controlled `coverage` offset from the current `SingleSubstFormat1` subtable and uses `this+coverage` to construct local iterator `iter`.
The staged patch deletes this catch-all by-value overload and permits only pointer/reference construction, preventing `hb_auto_t<Coverage::Iter>` from binding to a copied temporary Coverage object.
